annotation_source: Assistant visual inspection of the demo images; pending human review
task: Restore the current layout to the reference layout.
direction_convention: Directions are relative to the displayed image, not robot or world coordinates.

expected_actions.instruction: Move the cup down and left, and rotate it so its handle points right.
Move the beverage can upward to its reference position above the cup.

evaluation_notes: These are qualitative annotations based on assistant visual inspection, not official TTU task labels.
Directions describe movement from frame004.png to frame000.png.
Exact distances, rotation angles, and robot coordinates are not evaluated.
The beverage can's exact rotation is not evaluated.
Small rendering differences do not require moving an otherwise unchanged object.
Equivalent wording and different checklist ordering are acceptable.
Do not provide these expected actions to the model during inference; use them only to review its output.
A person should review these annotations before using them as an evaluation reference.
